lines.zh: 我弯着腰跑，一条胳膊甩着。
lines.en: I run hunched, one arm swinging loose.
My jaw hangs loose.

lines.zh: 我的脚掌拍在柏油路上。
lines.en: My soles slap the asphalt.

lines.zh: 我从一辆翻倒的车旁跑过。
lines.en: I run past an overturned car.

lines.zh: 我一边跑一边歪向左边。
lines.en: I veer left as I run.
My spine bends to an angle.
I crush a roof tile underfoot.

lines.zh: 我绕开一堆燃烧的木头。
lines.en: I skirt a pile of burning wood.

lines.zh: 我跑得不快，可方向很直。
lines.en: I'm not fast, but I go straight.
My breath whistles out of me.
I step over a road ditch.

lines.zh: 我的影子跟着我一路歪。
lines.en: My shadow lurches along with me.
I crouch with my jaw on my chest.
I push my dislocated arm back in.
I sniff the blood on the ground.
One shoulder rides higher than the other.
I bite at the air slowly.
I can't stand, so I crouch.
My eyes are clouded.
I listen to the sounds upstairs.
I'm missing two fingers.
I rest my forehead on the wall.
You stand straighter than I do.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，脖子响了一下。
lines.en: I raise my head and my neck clicks.
You look lively enough.
My jaw won't quite close.
You're backing away. I see it.
There's an old wound on your arm.
I cock my head and size you up.

lines.zh: 我爬在地上，抬头就是你的腿。
lines.en: I'm crawling low, and your legs are right there.
Don't stand above my head.
I stretch out one long arm.
My shoulder has slipped again.
I stoop back.
I make a wheezing sound.
That blow landed on my spine.
My arm hangs limp.
I lean on the wall and recover slowly.
Something came off. I don't look.
I'm more crooked than before.
You hit hard.
Bone snapped; I still stand.
I smell that warmth.

lines.zh: 那东西被你搁在地上了。
lines.en: You've put that thing on the ground.
I stoop in closer.
It's moving. Just what I want.

lines.zh: 我的嘴合不拢，牙全露着。
lines.en: My teeth are already bared.
I shuffle over, feet dragging.
I won't snatch; I'll sniff first.
I'll remember that smell.
Half a step closer.
My long fingers twitch.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，我的肩错开了。
lines.en: You hit me and my shoulder slips out.
I stoop aside.
My long arm sweeps you.
Don't push; I'm off balance.
We collide and I nearly drop to my knees.

lines.zh: 你的鞋跟压住我的指头。
lines.en: Your heel is on my fingertips.
I slide away along the wall's base.

lines.zh: 这一碰，我歪得更厉害了。
lines.en: That left me more crooked.
I grab your shoulder to steady.
I stagger back two steps.
Another comes near, hunched too.
We both cock our heads.

lines.zh: 它的下巴比我掉得更多。
lines.en: Its jaw hangs looser than mine.
We crouch in a row.
It nudges me with its long arm.
Our gasping becomes one breath.
We head down the same street.
It veers, and I veer with it.
Two shadows stick together.
Two of us on this street now.
I crouch to grab it. It's hard.
My long arm reaches it.

lines.zh: 我把它塞进嘴里，又掉出来。
lines.en: I put it in my mouth; it falls out.
I bite twice and can't open it.
I drag it a stretch.
This is very hard.
I huddle over it a long while.
Dropped it; I pick it up again.
I pin it under my knee.
I've no use for this.
Your shadow is still moving.
You've straightened up again. Good.
My spine snaps straight.
I click my jaw shut.
Living things are for biting.
I lunge at you.

lines.zh: 我的一条胳膊抬了起来。
lines.en: One of my arms comes up.
You can't get off this street.
I've fixed on your neck.
This time I won't be slow.
My knees have locked straight.
Blood tastes sweet in my mouth.
My steps have suddenly quickened.
Do you hear my shoulder grind?
I'll get my teeth in your hand.
I follow hunched all the way.
You go up, I go up.
My long arm feels ahead.
I move along the wall, silent.

lines.zh: 你的味道在这条走廊里。
lines.en: Your scent fills this corridor.
I listen to the echo of your steps.

lines.zh: 你一停，我的头就抬起来。
lines.en: When you stop, my head comes up.
I slip behind the door.

lines.zh: 你推开的那扇门，我记着。
lines.en: I remember the door you pushed.
My back is bowed very low.
You can hear my breathing.
One more corner.
Your blood smell grows nearer.
I dig my fingers into a crack.
You've backed into a dead end.
I crawl along the floor.
I moved, and you moved too.
Only one step left.
My long arm catches you.
I bite your forearm.
That ripped the cloth apart.
You break free and I lurch aside.

lines.zh: 我的指甲抠进你的手背。
lines.en: My nails dig into your hand.
I lunge again.
My weight bends you over.
I hear your bones creak.
My jaw knocks your shoulder.
You back to the stairwell.
I tumble down after you.
I get hold of your waist.
I don't let go, teeth clenched.
You can still struggle. Good.
My breathing grows louder.
This bite I mean to go through.
Something moves at the bottom of the stairs.

lines.zh: 我从一堆废纸里爬起来。
lines.en: I rise out of a heap of waste paper.
I come into the street, hunched.
The shadow on the wall falls wrong.
My jaw shows first.

lines.zh: 这里多了个长胳膊的影子。
lines.en: A long-armed shape joins this place.

lines.zh: 我从塌掉的门框下钻过。
lines.en: I squeeze under a collapsed doorframe.
I roll my shoulder and it clicks.

lines.zh: 街上开始有拖地的声音。
lines.en: Dragging sounds begin on the street.
I stop at the corner, head cocked.
My breathing arrives before I do.

lines.zh: 地上多了一道弯的脚印。
lines.en: A crooked set of prints appears.
I raise my head and find my heading.
This alley isn't quiet today.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的胳膊，皮缩了。
lines.en: Fire heats my arm and the skin shrinks.

lines.zh: 我从楼梯上滚下去，骨头响。
lines.en: I tumble down the stairs, bones clattering.

lines.zh: 水进了我的肺，我咳不出来。
lines.en: Water fills my lungs and I can't cough.
The blast slams me into the brick wall.

lines.zh: 一枚东西扎进我的长胳膊。
lines.en: Something sticks in my long arm.

lines.zh: 法术让我的肉一抽一抽。
lines.en: That spell makes my flesh jump.
Hunger won't let me stand straight.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，我抽成一团。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and I curl up.
The void hauls me down whole.
